Name: Mine Shaft Expansion
Author: SoapTastes0K
Description:
[size=5][b]Mine Shaft Expansion[/b][/size]
A complete, standalone C# SMAPI overhaul for Stardew Valley's mine shafts. Removes the vanilla 15-level drop cap with luck- and depth-scaled plunges, eliminates both the [i]"Jump in?"[/i] and [i]"You fell X levels!"[/i] UI pauses with zero frame flash, adds a smart [b]< 20% HP[/b] danger confirmation prompt, syncs fall audio to fast screen fades, and displays floors dropped using authentic non-blocking vanilla Stardew Valley overhead UI boxes.

[size=4][b]Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]No More 15-Level Cap (Uncapped Deep-Drop Chaining):[/b] Breaks past vanilla's 3–15 floor limit. Choose between [b]Uncapped Chain[/b] (default — repeatedly chains additional 3–8 floor plunges with no 15-level ceiling), [b]Custom Min–Max Range[/b] (up to 500 floors), or [b]Vanilla (3–15)[/b]. Daily Luck and Luck Buffs boost deep-drop odds, with an optional [b]Scale Drops With Depth[/b] toggle (+1 bonus floor per 50 Skull Cavern floors deep, up to +15).[/*]
[*][b]Smart Low-HP Warning Dialogue (Default: Below 20% HP):[/b] Pre-rolls and caches each shaft's drop depth per tile so fall-damage predictions match 1:1. Safe drops skip the prompt with [b]zero frame flash[/b]; if falling would leave your HP below 20% (configurable 0%–80%), a warning dialogue pops up with your predicted post-fall HP (and optional exact drop depth) so you can heal first.[/*]
[*][b]Zero-Pause Landing + Authentic Vanilla Overhead Notifications:[/b] Completely blocks the modal [i]"You fell X levels!"[/i] pause box for instant movement control on landing, replacing it with a non-blocking overhead notification using real Stardew Valley UI textures (automatically inherits UI recolor mods):
  • [b]Vanilla Dialogue Box[/b] (default, 0.8x UI scale — wood-framed parchment box)
  • [b]Vanilla NPC Bubble[/b] (native overhead NPC speech bubble)
  • [b]Vanilla Compact Box[/b] (slimmer vanilla wooden tooltip frame)
  • [b]Dark[/b], [b]HUD Toast[/b], [b]Box + HUD Toast[/b], or [b]Off[/b]
  • Plunges beyond 15 floors trigger a [b]Deep Drop![/b] highlight and crisp chime, and leaving the Mines/Skull Cavern shows a brief [b]Exit Run Summary[/b] toast.[/*]
[*][b]Milestone Floor Protection (Default: Floors 100 / 200 / 300):[/b] Prevents massive uncapped plunges from overshooting Mountain Mines Floor 100 (Stardrop) and Skull Cavern guaranteed Treasure Floors (100, 200, 300). Configurable to [i]Floors 100/200/300[/i], [i]Floor 100 Only[/i], or [i]Off[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Synced Fast Fade-Out & Fade-In (Default: 3x):[/b] Accelerates both the drop fade-to-black and the landing fade-in (1.0x–10.0x) and scales vanilla's falling/impact sound timers to match so audio never plays late.[/*]
[*][b]Regular Mines Shafts, Bonus Spawn Rate & Staircase Option:[/b] Optionally enable shafts on Mountain Mines floors 1–119 (always safely clamped at Floor 120), boost Skull Cavern natural rock-ladder-to-shaft conversion, and optionally allow crafted Staircases to roll for shaft conversion (Off by default so Staircases remain pure vanilla).[/*]
[*][b]Custom Fall Damage, Walk-Over Auto-Jump & Survival Tools:[/b] Tune [b]Fall Damage Per Level[/b] (default 3.0/lvl), set a [b]Max Fall Damage Cap[/b] or [b]Disable Shaft Fall Damage[/b], enable [b]Auto-Jump on Walk Over Shaft[/b], add [b]Post-Fall Invincibility[/b] (0–3s against frame-1 Serpent hits), toggle an optional [b]Deep-Drop Speed Boost[/b] (+1 Speed adrenaline burst that stacks with food and coffee), and enable [b]Exit Ladder Protection[/b] (hold Modifier Key to leave).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]GMCM Configuration Options[/b][/size]
All 34 settings apply live when clicking Save (no restart required):
[list]
[*][b]General:[/b] Mod Enabled (On), Modifier / Bypass Key (LeftShift)[/*]
[*][b]Shaft Depth & Generation:[/b] Drop Depth Mode (Uncapped Chain / Custom Min-Max / Vanilla), Min Drop Levels (3), Max Drop Levels (Uncapped / 0–500), Deep-Drop Chain Chance (55%), Luck Boosts Drop Depth (On), Scale Drops With Depth (Off), Protect Milestone Floors (Floors 100/200/300), Skull Cavern Bonus Shaft Rate (Vanilla / +0–100%), Staircases Can Become Shafts (Off), Enable Regular Mines Shafts (Off), Regular Mines Shaft Chance (15%)[/*]
[*][b]Zero-Delay & Transitions:[/b] Skip Jump Confirmation (On), Skip 'You Fell X Levels' Popup (On), Auto-Jump on Walk Over Shaft (Off), Fall Fade Speed (3.0x, 1.0x–10.0x), Fast Fade-In After Landing (On)[/*]
[*][b]Overhead Notification & Feedback:[/b] Notification Style (Overhead Box), Overhead Box Style (Vanilla Dialogue Box), Bubble Size (0.8x, 0.6x–2.0x), Bubble Vertical Offset (0 px), Bubble Duration (2.2s), Include Fall Damage (On), Highlight Deep Drops 16+ Floors (On), Show Exit Run Summary (On)[/*]
[*][b]Safety, Damage & Survival:[/b] Low-HP Warning Threshold (< 20%, 0%–80%), Reveal Drop Depth in Warning (Off), Disable Shaft Fall Damage (Off), Fall Damage Per Level (3.0/lvl), Max Fall Damage Cap (Uncapped / 0–200 HP), Post-Fall Invincibility (Off / 0–3s), Deep-Drop Speed Boost (Off / 0–10s), Exit Ladder Behavior (Vanilla / Protect / Instant)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]SMAPI Console Commands[/b][/size]
[code]mse_stats[/code]— Prints your current day's shafts jumped, total floors dropped, deepest single drop, and average drop.
[code]mse_spawn_shaft[/code]— Spawns a test shaft in front of your farmer inside the Mines or Skull Cavern.

[size=4][b]Recommended Companion Mods (Deep Mining Loadout)[/b][/size]
None of these are required, but they pair exceptionally well with deep uncapped Skull Cavern runs:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/963][b]Skull Cavern Elevator[/b][/url] — Saves elevator checkpoints as you plunge deeper so every massive shaft drop permanently extends your reach.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054][b]Vanilla Plus Professions (VPP)[/b][/url] — Expands Mining and Combat with 50+ professions and talents that reward deep dungeon delving.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720][b]Machine Progression System (MPS)[/b][/url] — Gives your endgame Iridium, Radioactive, and Prismatic hauls a real purpose by unlocking tiered upgrades for refining and artisan machines.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024][b]Machine Upgrade System (MUS)[/b][/url] — The core upgrade framework behind MPS, adding Iron through Prismatic drop-in machine upgrades.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28261][b]Machine Control Panel[/b][/url] — Lets you toggle specific machine rules and allowed inputs so your automated ore/gem processing never routes items into the wrong machine.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063][b]Automate[/b][/url] — Connects chests (and Junimo Chests) to your upgraded Furnaces, Crystalariums, and Geode Crushers to process massive deep-floor hauls hands-free.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518][b]Chests Anywhere[/b][/url] — Remotely stash overflowing ore, gems, and geodes straight into your farm's Automate chests mid-run without cutting a deep dive short.[/*]
[/list][i]More by SoapTastes0K:[/i] Pair with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/56023][b]Prismatic Bomb[/b][/url] for centered 25-tile endgame blasts to uncover shafts across an entire Skull Cavern floor in one detonation!

[size=4][b]Compatibility & Mod Conflict Warnings[/b][/size]
[color=#ff9900][b]IMPORTANT — Please read before installing alongside other mine/shaft mods:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Requirements:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6+ & SMAPI 4.0+ (uses SMAPI's built-in Harmony; no separate Harmony download needed).[/*]
[*][b]INCOMPATIBLE — Other Shaft-Skip / Auto-Confirm Mods:[/b] Do [b]NOT[/b] stack with mods that skip or auto-answer shaft prompts (such as [i]Instant Shaft[/i], [i]Confirm Mine Ladder[/i]'s shaft setting, [i]SkipInteraction[/i] on shafts, or older [i]Zero-Delay Shaft[/i] builds). Running two shaft interceptors together causes duplicate triggers, overlapping overhead UI boxes, and bypasses Mine Shaft Expansion's Low-HP Warning and custom fall damage.[/*]
[*][b]PARTIAL CONFLICT — Other Shaft Depth / Fall-Damage / Ladder Mods:[/b]
  • [b]Placeable Mine Shaft:[/b] Compatible if you set its
[code]SkipConfirmOnShaftJump[/code]option to
[code]false[/code]so Mine Shaft Expansion handles jumping and Low-HP Warnings.
  • [b]Other "Deeper Shafts", "No Fall Damage", or "Shaft Spawn Rate" mods:[/b] Patch the same
[code]MineShaft.enterMineShaft[/code]/
[code]afterFall[/code]/
[code]createLadderDown[/code]methods—the last mod loaded may overwrite drop depths or fall damage. Use only one mod for shaft depth/damage rules.[/*]
[*][b]VISUAL OVERLAP NOTE — Notification Bubble Mods:[/b] If you use [b]Farmer's Thoughts - Immersive Notification Bubbles[/b], set Mine Shaft Expansion's [i]Notification Style[/i] to [b]Overhead Box[/b] (or [b]HUD Toast[/b] alone)—do not use [i]Box + HUD Toast[/i], or two bubbles will stack above your head.[/*]
[*][b]FULLY COMPATIBLE:[/b] [b]Skull Cavern Elevator[/b], [b]Dialogue UI Unboxed[/b] (automatically styles the Low-HP Warning dialogue when triggered), [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], [b]Automate[/b], [b]Prismatic Bomb[/b], and UI recolor mods (automatically inherited by the vanilla overhead frames).[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer Note:[/b] Built and verified for single-player; multiplayer synchronization has not been extensively tested yet.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] (and optionally [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]).[/*]
[*]Remove any conflicting shaft-skip mods listed above.[/*]
[*]Install via Vortex (recommended) or extract the
[code]MineShaftExpansion[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

[list]
